description: OpenOA is a Python package maintained by its wind-energy research developers for operational analysis of wind plants. It organizes turbine SCADA, meteorological, revenue-meter and reanalysis inputs through a PlantData schema and provides methods for annual energy production and loss analysis. Available routines include uncertainty calculations and analyses of wake losses, gaps and yaw misalignment. Spatial coverage is the user-supplied wind plant; observation periods and time-series resolution depend on the input measurements and reanalysis. Public source, documentation and example workflows are available free under BSD-3-Clause. The package can help calibrate wind-generation assumptions and compare measured plant performance with simulated expectations. A limitation is that usable observations and their quality remain the responsibility of the analyst. The README explicitly says its static yaw-misalignment method has not been validated against known turbine misalignments. Existing data-era5-reanalysis is one documented weather input. This review inspected the repository and examples described in the README without downloading the measurements or executing an analysis.
